name: cost-guard
description: Shows what each chat, reply and day costs, nudges you to a fresh session when a chat gets long or heavy, and turns PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into markdown before Claude reads them.

warnAtTokens.title: Long chat: warn at (tokens)
warnAtTokens.description: Context size at which the meter turns yellow and suggests a fresh session. Every message re-sends the whole context.

urgeAtTokens.title: Long chat: urge a new session at (tokens)
urgeAtTokens.description: Context size at which the meter turns red and strongly recommends starting a fresh session.

warnAtUsd.title: Chat cost warning (USD)
warnAtUsd.description: Cost of one chat, in US dollars at API list prices, at which the meter warns.

replyToastUsd.title: Expensive reply alert (USD)
replyToastUsd.description: A single reply costing at least this much shows a toast.

largeFileKb.title: Large file (KB)
largeFileKb.description: An @-mentioned file at least this big gets a warning.

largePasteTokens.title: Large paste (tokens)
largePasteTokens.description: A message whose typed or pasted text is at least this many tokens gets a warning.

inlineMarkdownTokens.title: Converted file: read whole up to (tokens)
inlineMarkdownTokens.description: A converted document larger than this is attached as a preview of its first lines, with the path to read more only when needed.

longChatAction.title: When a chat passes the urge level
longChatAction.description: warn: show the red meter only. hold-once: also hold the next message once, explain the cost, and put the text back so Enter sends it anyway.

convertDocs.title: Convert documents to markdown
convertDocs.description: Turn PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF and EPUB files into a .md copy beside the original before Claude reads them.

localCurrencySymbol.title: Local currency symbol
localCurrencySymbol.description: Shown beside dollar figures, for example ₹. Leave empty to show dollars only.

usdToLocalRate.title: Local currency per US dollar
usdToLocalRate.description: Exchange rate used for the local figure, for example 84 for rupees. 0 turns the local figure off.
